Hi Matthew,

You're right, and I'm sorry. You chose the credit on October 30, I told you twice it was coming, and when I check your account this morning it still is not there. That is on us, not you.

I've escalated it properly now, and a colleague is picking it up today and will write to you to confirm the $200 is on your account. Once it's on, it applies automatically at checkout whenever you're signed in with this email address, so you'll see it come off the total yourself.

On the lotto miner, you're already in with the early bird deposit you placed, so you're on the list. The credit works on that order the same as any other, so the $200 comes off when it's time to complete it. I don't want to quote you a price or a date before that goes live, so the team will confirm both with you.

Your Harlo H15 Dual on Shop···· is unchanged and ships November 30.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Matthew.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
